description: This file defines the RedisClusteringOptions class and related components for configuring Redis-based clustering in Orleans. It includes properties for configuration options, methods to create Redis multiplexers and keys, a configuration validator, and some internal support classes.

classes.name: RedisClusteringOptions
classes.description: Holds configuration settings for Redis clustering, including connection options, multiplexer creation delegate, redis key creation delegate, and entry expiry.

classes.name: RedactRedisConfigurationOptions
classes.description: Internal class that redacts sensitive parts of the ConfigurationOptions, such as passwords.

classes.name: RedisClusteringOptionsValidator
classes.description: Validates the RedisClusteringOptions configuration to ensure required fields are set.

methods.name: DefaultCreateMultiplexer
methods.description: Default static method to asynchronously create a Redis connection multiplexer using the provided options.

methods.name: DefaultCreateRedisKey
methods.description: Default static method to generate a Redis key string based on cluster options.

methods.name: ValidateConfiguration
methods.description: Checks that the ConfigurationOptions property is not null and throws an exception if invalid.
